description: Produce a comprehensive fullstack audit report in markdown covering all 12 categories with detailed findings, file paths, line numbers, severity ratings, and recommended fixes.
steps: Create FULLSTACK_DEEP_AUDIT_REPORT.md in the project root
Document all findings across 12 categories with evidence from the codebase
Include severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), file path, line number, issue description, and recommended fix for each finding
acceptance_criteria: Report contains findings organized by all 12 categories
Each finding includes file path, line number or reference, severity, description, and recommended fix
Report is comprehensive and well-structured markdown
verification: Read the report file and confirm it covers all 12 categories with detailed findings
